title: No Longer Now at Eden's Gate
description: No Longer Now at Eden's Gate in Tonic Solfa to ST. AGNES, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns of the Greek Church (Edinburgh and London, 1900), headed “Let glory now the Cross adorn,”.
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Common Metre (8.6.8.6), and this page sets them to ST. AGNES; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: No lon-ger now at E-den's gate The fie-ry wea-pon gleams, But from the Cross that leads to life A light al-lur-ing streams.

lines: No longer now at Eden's gate
But from the Cross that leads to life
And now the power of Death is gone,
Grim Hades can no longer claim
For Thou, O Saviour, didst descend
And bad'st the souls in bondage held

source: John Brownlie, Hymns of the Greek Church (1900)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns of the Greek Church; set to ST. AGNES by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
